Name: Apple Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap changes an Item in the Toolbox into a Big Apple

Name: Big Blast Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap causes a huge blast within a 2-tile range, dealing 5d6 Fire Type Damage.

Name: Blast Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap causes a blast within a 1-tile range, dealing 3d6 Fire-Type Damage.

Name: Grimy Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap causes Food Items in the Toolbox will become Grimy Food. Roll a d6. On a 1-2, 1 Food is Grimy. On a 3-4, 2 Foods are Grimy. On a 5-6, 3 Foods are Grimy. Held Food will become Grimy Food.

Name: Grudge Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap causes enemy Pokémon on the Floor to arrive near you and hold a Grudge. You expend 3PP per Move you use on these Pokémon.

Name: Gust Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap sends you flying in a direction for 10 Tiles, doing 2d6 damage when you impact a wall or other Pokémon. If you hit another Pokémon,  it also does 2d6 damage to them.

Name: Hunger Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap empties your Belly, and you now treat your Belly as if you hadn’t eaten in 2 days.

Name: Mud Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap causes the Blinded Condition.

Name: Pitfall Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap causes you to fall from a Medium Height into a Pit. You can climb out of a Pitfall Trap with a Strength or Movement check. Flying-Type and Levitating Pokémon cannot be affected by this trap.

Name: Poison Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap causes the Poisoned Condition.

Name: Pokemon Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap transforms nearby Items on the ground into enemy Pokémon.

Name: PP Leech Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap lowers the PP of one of your moves to 0.

Name: Random Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap has a random effect on your party. This turns the trap into any other trap.

Name: Seal Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap seals one move so you can't use it until restored.

Name: Slow Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap lowers your Movement Modifier by 6.

Name: Slumber Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap causes the Asleep Condition.

Name: Spikes
Description: Stepping on this trap places spikes on 3 tiles in 2-tile radius that damages if the Pokémon enters the same Tile. Spikes can be stacked up to 3 times. Flying Pokémon and those that Levitate are unaffected.

Name: Spikey Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap drops Spikes on you, causing 25 damage.

Name: Spin Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap causes the Confused Condition.

Name: Stealth Rocks
Description: Stepping on this trap places rocks on 3 tiles in a 2-tile radius that damages if the Pokémon occupies the same tile. Can deal supereffective/not very effective damage.

Name: Sticky Trap
Description: An Item becomes Sticky. Sticky Items can be cleansed by leaving the Dungeon or using a Cleanse Orb.

Name: Summon Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap causes a group of enemy Pokémon to appear around you.

Name: Toxic Spikes
Description: Stepping on this trap places 3 spikes in a 2-tile radius that Poison if the Pokémon enters the same tile. Can be stacked, causing Badly Poisoned. Flying Pokémon and those that Levitate are unaffected.

Name: Trip Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap makes you drop your Held Item.

Name: Warp Trap
Description: Stepping on this trap warps you to somewhere else on the Floor.

Name: Wonder Tile
Description: Stepping on this tile resets and Stat Changes.

Name: Hazard Tile
Description: Used to Mark a Hazard. See Nearby Tiles.
